newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones cuts top executives' bonuses.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones cuts top executives' bonuses.

text.p: Bonuses for Dow Jones & Co.'s top executives were cut after the company's compensation committee determined its stock performance in the past year was not satisfactory.

According to the proxy statement filed by the publisher of the Wall Street Journal in advance of its April 16 annual meeting and made available Monday, Chairman and Chief Executive Peter Kann had his annual bonus cut to $380,000 for 1996 compared with $445,000 in the prior year.

The Independent Association of Publishers' Employees, which represents employees at Dow Jones, including the Wall Street Journal, also has put forth a stockholder proposal to create an independent review of top management and their performance.

President and Chief Operating Officer Kenneth Burenga's bonus was cut to $270,000 from $310,000; Senior Vice President Carl Valenti's was reduced to $155,000 from $220,000; and Senior Vice President Peter Skinner's dropped to $165,000 from $205,000.
Only Senior Vice President James Ottaway Jr's remained unchanged at $160,000.
The committee reported in the proxy statement that it compared Dow Jones' performance in 1996 with companies in the S&P 500 as well as the S&P's publishing and newspapers index.

"Overall, the committee determined that performance for the 1993-1996 period was less than fully satisfactory, particularly as measured by three financial criteria given significant weight by the committee: stock price performance, total stockholder return and return on equity," it said in the proxy statement.
The union-backed stockholder proposal was to be voted on at the annual meeting. The union holds 55 shares of Dow Jones' common stock and 10 shares of its Class B common stock.
Dow Jones has 73.9 million shares of common stock and 21.6 million shares of Class B common stock outstanding.
Dow Jones stock was off 37.5 cents at $42.625 in afternoon trading on the New York Stock Exchange. Its high for the last year is $46.125 vs. a low of $31.875.
